SELECT p.policy_number, COUNT(DISTINCT c.claim_identifier) AS claim_count
FROM claim AS c
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc ON cc.claim_identifier = c.claim_identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd ON pcd.policy_coverage_detail_identifier = cc.policy_coverage_detail_identifier
JOIN policy AS p ON p.policy_identifier = pcd.policy_identifier
GROUP BY p.policy_number

SELECT p.policy_number, COUNT(DISTINCT c.claim_identifier) AS claim_count
FROM claim AS c
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc ON cc.claim_identifier = c.claim_identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd ON pcd.policy_coverage_detail_identifier = cc.policy_coverage_detail_identifier
JOIN policy AS p ON p.policy_identifier = pcd.policy_identifier
GROUP BY p.policy_number;

SELECT p.policy_number, COUNT(DISTINCT c.claim_identifier) AS claim_count
FROM claim AS c
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc ON cc.claim_identifier = c.claim_identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd ON pcd.policy_coverage_detail_identifier = cc.policy_coverage_detail_identifier
JOIN policy AS p ON p.policy_identifier = pcd.policy_identifier
GROUP BY p.policy_number

JOIN premium AS pr ON pr.policy_amount_identifier = pa.policy_amount_identifier;
